description: The purpose of this notice is to close the loop for  Request for Information (RFI) 36C10B26Q0084, for Data Call Centers - RFI, which was posted on December 3, 2025.  VA has released a follow-on RFI, on March 2, 2026, using  Notice ID 36C10B26Q0224,  NAICS 541512  Computer Systems Design Services". Please review Notice ID 36C10B26Q0224 for additional information.
